title: Monotonicity of expected random restrictions
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $0\leq\delta\leq1$. For each subset $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let a fixed sign assignment on the indices outside $J$ determine a real-valued function, and suppose $g(J,z)\leq h(J,z)$ for every such $J$ and assignment $z$. Then the expected random restriction of $g$, with each subset weighted by $\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$ and averaged over the remaining signs, is at most the corresponding expected random restriction of $h$.
hypotheses_covered: $g(J,z)\leq h(J,z)$ for every subset $J$ and assignment $z$
